scope: Recorded observations for one owner-authorized TV; this release-preparation pass is local/offline and does not reconfigure the TV.

latest_live_verify.source: Last guarded verify recorded in the same-device couchy-hdmi-usb private reserve
latest_live_verify.scope: Profile/HOME/selected five installed APK hashes/APK-source default-off/photo policy and read permission; not actual playback/PIN/reset retention

profile_and_recovery.evidence: Privacy apply/rollback/reapply and no-op reapply checked; HOME temporary switches and exact per-device local choice/absence restored before final owner selection. Original-value same-device journals retained. No uninstall/full app-data rollback implied.

drift.evidence: After accelerated sleep and owner wake, read-only verify found com.cltv.fast enabled and secure send_action_app_error=1. Reviewed apply changed only these two values with an exact-original-value journal. Final read-only verify passed, including photo policy and both APK sources deny. Cause and restart persistence are not established.
drift.latest_storage_audit: This read-only verify found only secure send_action_app_error reset to 1. Journaled apply restored 0; subsequent full verify passed. Recurrent OEM change cause remains unproven; no automatic repair daemon added.

projectivy.custom_wallpaper_and_themes: Premium screen observed; not activated or bypassed

plume.role: Installed alternative, private data not cleared
plume.telemetry_limit: Source includes daily GitHub update checks and optional IP weather; no zero-network claim

couchy.wallpaper: Exact reviewed JPEG visibly rendered, copied into private internal app storage by normal picker; no USB dependency.

languages.ru: Actual settings labels checked through native picker
languages.es: Startup and final actual settings/date checked; explicit Español selected
languages.en: Native per-app en-US and normal imported language=en each displayed English; per-app override restored to original empty
languages.system_default_caveat: After RU/EN trials, choosing system default left Russian date/UI despite es-ES system and empty native per-app locale; ordinary process relaunch did not resolve it. Explicit Español corrected the observed mismatch.

couchy.native_json_import: Passed through Material Files document picker; six apps and wallpaper retained
couchy.native_json_export: Save configuration successfully wrote Download/CouchyBackup.json; valid 30-key JSON pulled privately; final Spanish export checked separately in final backup manifest.
couchy.temporary_home_rollback: Couchy HOME verified, then exact original Plume HOME and originally absent local selection restored before final owner choice
couchy.final_home: Explicit owner chose Couchy; HOME and saved serial/fingerprint selection verified
couchy.input_selector: Native selector opened/closed without changing an input; no new external video signal test

usb_photo_screensaver.timing_calculation: idle=5*60*1000=300000 ms; total sleep=30*60*1000=1800000 ms; intended photo session=(30-5)=25 minutes; image interval=30*1000=30000 ms
usb_photo_screensaver.signing_material: Private ignored tools/photo-signing preserved for signed updates; no keys/images/APKs in public archive.
usb_photo_screensaver.image_rendering: Owner confirmed actual USB photos visible; interval, corrupt skip, pause and wrap verified. Native MediaTek fullscreen rendering is a separate unconfirmed path.
usb_photo_screensaver.manual_preview: Holds awake until closed; not the automatic 25-minute session.

home_input_usb_shortcuts.apk_integrity: Local signing certificates, aapt2 package/zero-permission checks and both installed SHA-256 values verified
home_input_usb_shortcuts.layout: Original six cards retained in the same order; HDMI and USB appended; XS (iconScale=0) makes all eight visible without scrolling; custom JPEG/clock/date retained
home_input_usb_shortcuts.input_list: TvInputManager returned the registered HDMI1/HW5, HDMI2/HW6, HDMI3/HW7 and AV/HW2 sources; exact reviewed device IDs only
home_input_usb_shortcuts.selection_evidence: Pressing OK in original Inputs helper opened factory TV and created an active tv_input session for HDMIInputService/HW5. External picture unverified; HDMI2/3/AV not newly selected in this check.
home_input_usb_shortcuts.initial_oem_panel_trial: com.android.tv.action.VIEW_INPUTS launched InputsPanelActivity but no usable list was observed; not used in final code
home_input_usb_shortcuts.usb_connected_browser: With one mounted removable drive, browse/photo controls enabled. Browse USB files opened com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer foreground; no file opened or media playback started.
home_input_usb_shortcuts.dynamic_state_scope: Inside USB page only; HOME USB card remains present
home_input_usb_shortcuts.local_checks: Temporary isolated install/idempotence/corrupt-second-artifact-before-mutation and real make -j8 build/install/failure ordering checks passed. Existing launcher variants/five-app verification and base/photo Make orchestration passed. No permanent tests added.

updated_private_reserve.includes: Exact native eight-card Couchy JSON, original JPEG, both shortcut APKs/private signing material, local profile/selection/locks and final verified state

smarttube.evidence: Public Big Buck Bunny video displayed; media_session reported PLAYING with no error; no Google account added

netflix.evidence: Existing factory app launches; no Netflix credentials entered

browser.evidence: TV Bro 2.1.6 APK SHA-256 matched the pin; Wikipedia displayed on a fresh launch. Browser remains in the Grunkel app row and in the default five-app installer.

iptv.evidence: OpenTV loaded TDTChannels M3U8 and displayed La 1 video; not all channels/languages tested

iphone_mirroring.evidence: Owner explicitly reported that the TV appeared and the image was transmitted; mDNS service also observed locally

android_casting.evidence: Owner reported YouTube casting from Redmi 15C working. This establishes application casting, not full Android screen mirroring.

native_media.evidence: Native browser showed drives/folders/thumbnails. Fullscreen native photo/video ADB areas were black; on-TV native picture/audio was not confirmed. No protected-surface cause inferred. Original Photos app rendering was independently confirmed.

zero_telemetry.evidence: Optional feedback/personalization packages disabled; native init.svc.acrservice still running; consent state inconclusive

speedup.evidence: No controlled timing comparison. Last after snapshot ended on AirPlay rather than HOME, so before/after idle comparison is invalid; improved perf helper now checks resumed activity before/after sampling.

pre_couchy_plume.checks: Every SHA-256 plus ZIP CRC and byte parity
pre_couchy_plume.contains: Pinned APKs, toolkit/configuration snapshot, current screenshot and recovery notes

final_sources.includes: Exact native eight-card Couchy JSON, original JPEG, both shortcut APKs/private signing material, local profile/selection/locks and final verified state

private_reserves.pre_cleanup: Private *-before-stable-cleanup.zip preserves all 52 prior public files, full previous evidence/AGENTS and removed public images; hashes/ZIP verified. Not exported.

release_preparation.checked: Python/JSON/XML; 13 matching EN/ES/RU anchors and local links; official launcher APK URLs; exact image SHA-256; locale-key parity; profile guards; private-data-aware ZIP CRC/byte parity
release_preparation.negative_checks: Corrupt image, broken local link, private network address and extra screenshot refused in temporary public-only copies
release_preparation.launcher_initialization_examples: All nine install/menu/configure commands for Couchy/Projectivy/Plume exercised through real make -j8 with an isolated command recorder, not live TV installation
release_preparation.existing_behavior_checks: Launcher selection/precedence/idempotence/rollback; selected-five-only verification; shortcut install/failure-stop; base/photo Make ordering; HID/SSH guards; installer/file-access app-op rollback

language_and_reset_policy.note: Read-only factory locale is not proof of the OEM first-run wizard choice after reset. Current language changes do not set factory-reset defaults.

limitations: Only exact recorded board/build tested; retail model name is not a compatibility guarantee.
No firmware/root/unlock/reset/partition write. Factory-reset Spanish default not implemented; read-only factory locale reports en-US.
Full production 30-minute photo/sleep cycle and reboot/factory-reset retention not tested.
Netflix account playback, full Android mirroring, physical USB/Bluetooth keyboard/mouse and cross-site desktop/SSH unverified.
No permanent-speedup or zero-telemetry claim. Native vendor ACR remained running.
HOME USB tile stays visible; only controls in its page turn grey when a drive is absent.
Connected/standby TV input status and an active input session do not independently prove external video picture.
evidence_privacy: Exactly two unedited public PNGs plus one reusable JPEG, explicit path/SHA-256 whitelist. Owner media, package inventories, addressing, raw logs, APKs, signing/ADB keys and reserves remain private.
